Hi Vanessa / team,

Thanks for flagging and for the attachments. We reviewed the manifest and there are two issues:
- One line item is missing a unit value on the commercial invoice (customs needs the declared value for dutiable goods).
- The net weight on the manifest (per-pallet) does not match the weight declared on the B/L — this typically triggers secondary inspection.

Options and estimated timelines/costs:
1) Provide corrected commercial invoice (value + HS codes) and request immediate release: ~2–4 hours if customs accepts the correction electronically. No bond required if values are updated and there is no prohibited content.
2) Temporary release on a single-trip bond for inspection: same-day possible, bond premium ~USD 220 plus administration fees. Release contingent on deposit/guarantee.
3) Reconsign to the venue (if venue accepts liabilities): requires a reconsignment instruction and carrier amendment; ~4–6 hours and usual reconsignment fee charged by carrier/forwarder.

Action we need from you right now:
- Corrected commercial invoice (PDF) with per-line values and HS codes.
- Confirmation if Redwood will accept the reconsignment cost or prefers to supply the corrected invoice.

If you decide to go the bond route we can initiate immediately; we will need a signed authorization form (I can send it now). If you want to reconsign, please confirm venue contact name for acceptance so we can update the consignee.

Best,
